answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 164072 Country: INDIA Title: Is verbal utterance necessary for an oath to be valid or will an oath be formed if a firm intention is made in the heart without saying it loudly with the mouth and tongue? Question: Is verbal utterance necessary for an oath to be valid or will an oath be formed if a firm intention is made in the heart without saying it loudly with the mouth and tongue? Answer ID: 164072 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1230/902/SN=11/1439) Yes! It is mandatory for the validity of oath to be uttered verbally. According to Shariah, oath does not come into effect merely by making intention in the heart. In such case if one goes against it then according to Shariah there is no kaffarah. (See: Shami 5:473, pub. Zakaria) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
